fieldValues.title: Clerk canary
fieldValues.description: Daily: run clerk doctor in a cloud session with every governed repo attached and post its clerk-doctor marker on the digest issue, ok or fail; also run clerk routines --check when a trigger-listing tool is available. Changes nothing else.
fieldValues.done_when: One clerk-doctor marker comment from this run is on semanticops.com#33. The desk flags a failing marker, or no cloud marker for 26 hours.
